# Diyama Solutions

> Diyama Solutions Ltd builds and runs business systems, automation and software for businesses in Zambia and abroad, from Lusaka and Livingstone. Its four lead offers are Front Desk on WhatsApp, Lodge Desk, Automation Sprint and Office System. It also continues its marketing, social media, design and web work and offers a suite of free, ready to use business apps. Tagline: Clarity in Action.

Diyama helps entrepreneurs, SMEs and established companies get found online, win customers and run their operations with less friction. We practise what we advise: the same growth systems and software we build for clients, we run and offer ourselves.

## Services
- [All services](https://diyama.online/services): 20 services across Marketing & Growth, Strategy & Consulting, Creative & Content, Digital & Tech, Industry Specific and Web3. Includes digital marketing, social media management, growth strategy, branding, web development, SEO, content and more.
- [Book a consultation](https://diyama.online/consultations): Start with a focused session to map your next 90 days.
- [Diyama AI advisor](https://diyama.online/ai): A free AI business advisor, available 24/7, no signup.
- [Business Fit generator](https://diyama.online/business-fit): Answer a few questions and get a free personalized business kit with recommendations, quick wins and next steps.

## Free business apps (try instantly, no signup)
- [DREADR](https://dreadr.diyama.online/): Open PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB, email and ZIP files on your phone. Files never leave the device, works offline.
- [Diyama Invoicer](https://diyama.online/apps/invoicer): Create professional invoices and download branded PDFs.
- [Diyama QR Studio](https://diyama.online/apps/qr-studio): Generate QR codes for links, WhatsApp, WiFi and contact cards.
- [Diyama Quote Builder](https://diyama.online/apps/quotation): Build and download professional quotations.
- [Diyama BookMe](https://diyama.online/apps/bookme): Take appointments with automatic time slots and WhatsApp confirmations.
- [Diyama BioLink](https://diyama.online/apps/biolink): Build a shareable link in bio page for your business.
- [Diyama PaySlip](https://diyama.online/apps/payslip): Calculate Zambian PAYE, NAPSA and NHIMA and download payslips.
- [Diyama StockTrack](https://diyama.online/apps/stocktrack): Track inventory with low stock alerts and stock value.
- [Diyama Expensa](https://diyama.online/apps/expensa): Track income and expenses with live charts.
- [Diyama TapCard](https://diyama.online/apps/tapcard): Create a digital business card with a QR code and vCard.
- [Diyama Loyalty](https://diyama.online/apps/loyalty): Run digital loyalty stamp cards for your shop or cafe.
- [All apps](https://diyama.online/apps): The full range, including Diyama POS, the eClass learning platform and the World Clock display.
